meta.title: Humanitarian Response Venezuela
meta.description: A national humanitarian response platform in Venezuela connecting aid centers, hospitals, volunteers, rescuers, and families.
meta.ogDescription: Coordination for aid centers, hospitals, volunteers, rescuers, donations, and family reports in Venezuela.
meta.twitterDescription: Aid centers, supplies, volunteers, rescuers, and family search.
meta.imageAlt: Visual humanitarian coordination dashboard for Venezuela
meta.jsonLdDescription: National humanitarian response platform for aid centers, hospitals, volunteers, rescuers, donations, and families.

hero.title: Humanitarian Response Venezuela
hero.subtitle: Connect aid centers, hospitals, volunteers, rescuers, donations, and family reports in one mobile operations desk.

dashboard.title: Operations Dashboard
dashboard.copy: A consolidated view to prioritize calls, registrations, and supply transfers.

help.title: How to help
help.copy: Three direct ways to support verified operations.
help.donateCopy: Deliver water, medicine, food, or equipment to registered centers.
help.volunteerCopy: Share your city, profession, and availability to coordinate local support.
help.reportCopy: Update centers, phone numbers, and needs with confirmed data.

urgent.title: Urgent needs
urgent.copy: Priorities calculated from the platform's current records.

map.title: Aid centers and operations
map.copy: Hospitals, shelters, collection centers, and aid points in a map-ready structure.
map.emptyCopy: The center list works with text locations. The map will accept latitude and longitude when available.

centers.title: Aid centers
centers.copy: Centers, hospitals, and shelters with needs, availability, and contacts.
centers.formCopy: Register needs or availability; it is saved instantly to the database.
centers.geoUnavailable: Your browser cannot use location. Search by city or area instead.
centers.geoDenied: We could not access your location. Search by city or review your browser permission.
centers.nearCopy: Search by location or supply, review the center's information, and confirm before going.
centers.ayudaCopy: Find a center, review its availability, and confirm the information before going.
centers.donarTitle: Where to donate what you have
centers.donarCopy: Find an active need and coordinate delivery with the center.
centers.searchLabel: Search by name, area, or supply
centers.mapAria: Map of centers with an available location
centers.mapCoverage: {count} of {total} centers have a location on the map
centers.confirmBeforeGoing: Information can change. Confirm with the center before traveling or delivering supplies.
centers.whatsappText: Hello, I saw your center's information on Humanitarian Response Venezuela. I would like to confirm the details before coming.

volunteers.formCopy: The information is stored securely in the platform database.

rescuers.title: Rescuer Registration
rescuers.copy: Specialized teams, operational capacity, and rescue logistics separated from general volunteering.
rescuers.formCopy: The registration is stored securely in the platform database.
rescuers.summaryCopy: Use this tab for profiles with technical capacity, equipment, or operational affiliation.
rescuers.listCopy: Filter by specialty, organization, or location to activate teams.
rescuers.privateCopy: Rescuer profiles contain contact, location, and operational capacity data.
rescuers.privateAdminCopy: The full list is not shown publicly. Administrators can view it after validating the admin key.

drivers.title: Solidarity transporters
drivers.copy: Operational ranking for existing routes and logistics support.

family.title: Find family
family.copy: Search by name or ID in the reported-persons registry.
family.errorMessage: This search could not be completed.
family.notFound: We did not find this person in the available records.
family.supportLine: Psychological support line: pending official publication.
family.reportCopy: Register a located, hospitalized, or missing person. The report stays marked as unverified until the team confirms it.
family.reportSaved: Report saved. It will remain unverified until the team confirms it.
family.reportError: The report could not be saved

tracking.title: Donation tracking
tracking.copy: Look up the public traceability record for an invoice with the token shared with the donor.
tracking.invalidToken: Enter a token in the DV-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX format.
tracking.notFound: No invoice was found for that token.
tracking.error: The traceability record could not be read.
tracking.noHistory: No financial movements have been published for this invoice.
tracking.noEvidence: No public evidence has been published for this invoice.

modal.driverIntro: Add your details so centers know who can move supplies and how to contact you.
modal.nameHelp: Use the name shown on your ID.
modal.vehicleHelp: Choose the vehicle you will use for deliveries.
modal.phoneHelp: We use this number to coordinate a pickup.
modal.emailHelp: We will send your sign-in code here.
modal.zoneHelp: Enter the city or area where you can usually operate.
modal.plateHelp: Enter the full plate exactly as it appears on the vehicle.
modal.photosIntro: For safety, take 3 photos with your camera: the plate, the vehicle and your ID card. Only the verification team will see them.
modal.photoPlateHelp: Frame the whole plate and make sure every character is readable.
modal.photoVehicleHelp: Show the complete vehicle from an angle that makes it recognizable.
modal.photoIdHelp: Make sure your name and ID number are visible without glare.
modal.cameraIdle: The camera opens here after you allow access.
modal.cameraReady: Camera ready. Check the frame and take the photo.
modal.cameraPermission: The browser blocked the camera. Allow access in the address bar and try again.
modal.cameraUnavailable: The camera could not open. Check permission and try again.
modal.cameraUnsupported: This browser cannot open the camera. Use an updated browser.
modal.cameraNotReady: Wait for the camera image before taking the photo.

messages.whatsappText: Hi, I saw on Humanitarian Response Venezuela that help is needed. How can I contribute?
messages.reportError: We could not save the report. Check the connection and try again.

donations.title: Humanitarian Donation Center
donations.copy: National coordination for collection centers, hospitals, volunteers, rescuers, and public traceability.
donations.dashboardCopy: Consolidated indicators from the platform's live records.
donations.urgentCopy: Critical hospitals, centers with extreme shortages, and medical emergencies.
donations.mapCopy: Regional summary ready for future geographic integration when verified coordinates exist.
donations.needsCopy: Dynamic ranking by request volume and operational urgency.
donations.impactCopy: Operational counters calculated from available records.
donations.historyCopy: Prepared for Pending, In progress, and Delivered statuses.
donations.alliesCopy: Structure prepared for NGOs, hospitals, universities, companies, and community centers.
donations.transparencyCopy: The requests shown come from documented records inside the platform. The information can be audited and validated through records stored in the database.
donations.emptySection: No records for this section with the current filters.

transparency.exampleValidation: Visible example until compatible columns are received

medicalEquipment.copy: Clinical supplies, equipment, and medical material.

fuel.title: Fuel
fuel.copy: Support for routes, ambulances, and logistics.

panel.title: My center panel
panel.intro: Enter your center token and PIN to update needs and supplies live.
panel.noSupplies: This center has no registered supplies yet.
panel.createIntro: Register your center and set a PIN. You will get an access token shown ONLY once.
panel.tokenCreated: Panel created. Save this token: it is shown only once.
panel.tokenHint: To sign in later: the “Manage my center” button or the #centro/YOUR-TOKEN link, plus your PIN.
panel.geoUnavailable: Your browser does not support geolocation
panel.catalogIntro: Tap what your center needs. If it is not here, add it with “Other supply”.

admin.title: Traceability administration
admin.intro: Team module: invoices, donations, evidence, and verification. Requires the admin key.
admin.invoiceCreated: Invoice created. Save the number and token: the token is shared with donors.
admin.tokenHint: Save it now: it will not be shown in full again.
admin.pickInvoice: First pick an invoice with “Operate this invoice”
admin.panelRegenerated: Panel regenerated. Hand the new token and PIN to the center.
admin.budgetIntro: Quote a needed supply at a specific store (you can create several budgets for the same supply at different stores). Donors will see the price and what is missing in real time.
admin.budgetCreated: Budget created. It is now visible to donors.
admin.vacancyIntro: Publish which volunteers are needed and where; they appear instantly in the public section.
admin.vacancyDescPh: Requirements, what to bring, who to report to…
admin.rescuersIntro: These profiles are available only to the administrator team.
admin.consoleSubtitle: Pick a task. Each one guides you step by step.
admin.taskDonationDesc: Money that arrives not tied to a supply
admin.taskBudgetDesc: A supply quote from a store
admin.taskVacancyDesc: Which volunteer is needed and where
admin.vacancyLive: The role is now live in the volunteers section.
admin.regenIntro: Generate a fresh token and PIN for an existing center's panel.

home.footLink: Track your donation with your code

helpHub.rescuerCta: I'm a rescuer or rescue team
helpHub.reportSummary: Report outdated info or a center

transportHub.copy: Move supplies from where they're spare to where they're needed.

transfers.title: Suggested transfers

centerHub.title: Centers and teams
centerHub.copy: Credentialed access. None of this appears in the public menu.
centerHub.panelCopy: Update needs, available supplies and contact details with your token + PIN.
centerHub.createCopy: Only if your center is not in the directory yet.
centerHub.adminNote: The admin module (invoices, traceability, verification) opens via direct access with a key.

needs.title: Open needs
needs.copy: Pick what is missing and which center. When you donate you get a code to follow your help until the center receives it.
needs.donateCta: I have it, I want to donate it
needs.invalidAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
needs.error: Your donation could not be registered.
needs.budgetsCopy: Each budget is a real quote for a supply at a store. Donate money and follow the whole cycle: purchase, pickup and delivery to the center.
needs.inKindTitle: Already have the supply? Offer it here
needs.missing: {faltan} still missing to complete the purchase

access.title: Register or sign in
access.copy: Pick your role. If you already have credentials, go straight in.
access.driverCopy: Register your vehicle and area to move supplies between centers.
access.volunteerCopy: Sign up with your area, profession and availability.
access.centerCopy: Enter your panel with token + PIN, or register a new center.
access.loginCopy: Enter your email and we will send you a 6-digit code to sign in. Works for drivers, volunteers and centers.
access.loginCta: I have an account: sign in
access.sending: Sending the code to your email…
access.codeSent: Code sent to {email}. Check your inbox (and spam) and paste it here.
access.sendError: Could not send the code. Try again in a minute.
access.verifyError: Wrong or expired code. Request a new one if more than 60 minutes have passed.
access.codeFormat: The code is 6 digits, exactly as it arrived in your email.
access.noRoles: This email has no registrations. Register first as a driver, volunteer or center.
access.welcome: Identity verified. This is your profile:

money.simNote: Simulated payment for now: confirming generates your transaction reference. Once the bank account is connected, you will pay and use the real reference.
money.thanksTitle: Thank you! Your contribution is registered
money.thanksBought: Goal reached! {insumo} can now be purchased: a driver will pick it up and you will see every step with your code.
money.thanksPartial: Your contribution to {insumo} adds up. {recaudado} of {precio} so far: once complete, you will see the purchase, pickup and delivery with your code.

cycle.title: Purchased supplies, ready for pickup
cycle.copy: Donors already paid for these supplies. Pick them up at the store with photos of the site and the supply, and deliver them to the center registering who receives.
cycle.pickupCopy: You are picking up {insumo} at {tienda} ({direccion}). Take one photo of the site and one of the supply.
cycle.deliverCopy: You are delivering {insumo} at {centro}. Register the person receiving and a photo of the supplies.

offer.modalTitle: Offer a supply I already have
offer.modalCopy: Say what you have, how much and where it is. A driver will pick it up and take it to a center.
offer.modalCopyCentro: You are offering {insumo} for {centro}. Say how much you have and where to pick it up.
offer.contactNamePh: The person handing over the supply
offer.cameraStepTitle: Take a photo of the supply
offer.cameraStepCopy: The photo is captured from this app's camera. Device files are not accepted.
offer.cameraRequired: Take a photo of the supply to continue.
offer.cameraUnavailable: We could not open the camera. Check browser permission and try again.
offer.cameraUnsupported: This device cannot use the camera from the browser.
offer.reviewCopy: Confirm the details before publishing so a driver can coordinate with you.
offer.privacyNote: Your location and phone will be shown to drivers to coordinate the pickup.
offer.thanksTitle: Thank you! Your donation is published
offer.thanksCopy: A driver will see it with your location and contact you to pick it up. Save this code to track it.
offer.listTitle: Offered donations, located and ready for pickup
offer.listCopy: People who already have the supply and are waiting for you to pick it up: quantity, location and phone to coordinate. Take it to a center that needs it.
offer.pickupCopy: You are picking up {cantidad} {unidad} of {insumo} at {ubicacion}. Say which center you will take it to.
offer.destPh: Name of the center that needs it
offer.pickupSaved: Pickup registered. Thanks for the transport!
offer.pageTitle: I have a supply to donate
offer.pageCopy: Tell us what you have, show photos and say where to pick it up. A driver will come for it.
offer.photosCopy: Open the camera and take up to 20 photos of the supply. At least one.
offer.cameraReady: Camera ready: take the photo when you want.
offer.photosRequired: Take or upload at least one photo of the supply.
offer.idCopy: To verify the donation. It is not shown publicly.
offer.idRequired: The photo of your ID is missing.
offer.gpsUnsupported: This browser does not support GPS.
offer.gpsError: Couldn't get your location. Pick the spot on the map.
offer.mapHint: Tap the map or drag the marker to the exact spot.
offer.geoRequired: Set the pickup point with GPS or on the map.
offer.cameraIdle: The camera opens here once you allow it.
offer.placeCopy: Set the exact spot, give it a reference name and take a photo of the place.
offer.refHelp: How to recognize the place on arrival. The address comes from the map.
offer.refRequired: Write a reference name for the place.
offer.placePhotoCopy: A photo of the entrance or the exact spot the driver has to reach.
offer.placePhotoRequired: Take a photo of the pickup place.

vacancies.registerSummary: Ready to help? Sign up as a volunteer
